children: Royal Caribbean Cruises agreed to acquire a 50% equity interest in Sandals and Beaches Resorts for approximately $3.0 billion in cash.
Signed definitive agreements to acquire 50% of Sandals and Beaches Resorts for about $3.0 billion in cash.
Secured committed debt financing from Morgan Stanley to fund the investment.
Transaction implies a forward EBITDA multiple of ~10x and is expected to be accretive to earnings in the year after close.
Deal expected to close in early 2027, subject to customary approvals and closing conditions.
Joint venture will combine resort portfolios and explore broader distribution, guest engagement and integrated vacation offerings.
